set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 4 Release infrastructure.

Publishing is off; no version tag or MiMa baseline exists; the docs site is not deployed. The coordinate io.github.bbuchsbaum and scmInfo landed at 0e36a7fa.

Scope:
Release plumbing.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The Sonatype namespace for io.github.bbuchsbaum is verified (publishing requires it).
2. Publishing is enabled in build.sbt with secrets configured.
3. A version tag exists and MiMa is wired to it as the baseline.
4. The docs site is deployed at a recorded URL and `npm run verify` passes in CI.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 4: release infrastructure -- publishing, MiMa baseline, deployed docs
